intent: Fix a race in addrConn where concurrent connect() calls both saw the subchannel as Idle because connect() released ac.mu before resetTransport() re-acquired it and set Connecting, producing parallel connection attempts and an orphaned transport (issue #7365). resetTransport becomes resetTransportAndUnlock, so callers keep ac.mu held across the Idle check and the transition to Connecting.
residual_risks: updateAddrs now hands ac.mu to the spawned resetTransportAndUnlock goroutine, so the deferred ac.transport.GracefulClose() (which synchronously calls onClose and locks ac.mu) waits until that goroutine unlocks after setting Connecting. This is safe today (acbw.updateState only schedules on a serializer; onClose then returns early on the cancelled old ctx; every return path unlocks exactly once), but a future blocking call added before the unlock in resetTransportAndUnlock would also stall that deferred close.

updateAddrs with an empty address list: tryAllAddrs over zero addresses returns nil, so resetTransportAndUnlock takes the success path and leaves the subchannel in Connecting with no transport. Pre-existing and unchanged by this diff.
testing_gaps: No regression test was added. Nothing deterministically drives two concurrent connect() calls (or connect racing updateAddrs) on an Idle addrConn and asserts a single connection attempt; coverage depends on the flaky Test/AuthorityRevive.
